findings.evidence: `Mathlib/Algebra/Ring/Commute.lean:263` defines `Commute.lie_eq`; Mathlib itself uses `Matrix.commute_diagonal` with `commute_iff_lie_eq` in `LinearAlgebra/RootSystem/GeckConstruction/Basic.lean:134`.
findings.fix: Replace the final calculation with `exact (Matrix.commute_diagonal d e).lie_eq`.
findings.issue: The proof of `lie_eq_zero_of_isDiag` unfolds the associative Lie bracket although `Commute.lie_eq` already performs exactly this conversion.

findings.evidence: `Mathlib/LinearAlgebra/Dual/Basis.lean:125` provides `Basis.toDualEquiv`, while lines 76–80 there identify its pairing with basis coordinates and lines 152–155 identify dual coordinates.
findings.fix: Define it as `(diagonalEquiv R n).trans (diagonalCartanBasis R n).toDualEquiv` and derive the coordinate theorem using the basis API; import `Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Dual.Basis`.
findings.issue: `glWeightEquiv` manually reconstructs the finite-basis equivalence with the dual, including its inverse and both inverse proofs.

summary: Two implementations rederive existing Mathlib API instead of reusing it.
